The Brand

The Logo Decoded

Five letters. Five symbols. Five meanings. One global spirit.

W

Wheat 小麦

Yellow W represents Wheat. The golden grain that provides aroma and complexity.

R

Rice 大米

White R represents Rice. The pure grain that delivers smoothness and clarity.

Corn + Earth 玉米/地球

Yellow C-shaped sickle represents Corn. The blue globe represents the world and international vision.

D

Durra 高粱

Red D represents Durra (Sorghum). The bold grain that gives body and backbone.

G

Glutinous Rice 糯米

White G represents Glutinous Rice. The sweet grain that adds depth and richness.

Five Colors. Infinite Cocktails.
The colorful lettermark draws from Google's playbook — modern, digital, globally iconic. Five colors for five grains. Five colors for the infinite cocktails this spirit can create.
Brand DNA
The brand name encodes all five grains: W-Wheat (yellow), R-Rice (white), D-Durra/Sorghum (red), G-Glutinous Rice (white), and the 5 with blue globe representing Corn + the world. The C-shaped sickle pays homage to Remy Martin's spear and Hennessy's axe — claiming a place in the noble lineage of luxury spirits. The colorful letters mirror Google's iconic branding, signaling modernity and global reach. Pronounced "Rodge Five."

Brand Heritage

Noble Roots.
Modern Spirit.

The C-shaped sickle in our logo pays homage to the great houses of cognac — Remy Martin's spear, Hennessy's axe. These symbols once marked the finest spirits in the world. Now, the sickle marks the arrival of a new global classic.

Our colorful lettermark draws from Google's playbook — instantly recognizable, universally approachable, digitally native. Five colors for five grains. Five colors for the infinite cocktails can create.

Noble Lineage Digital-Native Globally Iconic
This slide bridges tradition and modernity — the two pillars of the brand. The cognac reference establishes credibility and aspiration. The Google reference signals accessibility and viral potential. Together, they position WRD G⁵ as both prestigious and approachable.

Pillar 02

The Opportunity

The cocktail world has four base spirits. It's time for the fifth.

Section divider. The "fifth base spirit" positioning is the core strategic insight — we're not asking consumers to try a "Chinese spirit." We're offering them a new tool for creativity.

The Market Gap

Vodka. Gin. Rum. Whiskey. And Now — .

For decades, cocktails have been built on four pillars. introduces the fifth — a base spirit with unmatched complexity, born from five grains and 600+ years of craft.

The Old Guard

Vodka (neutral), Gin (botanical), Rum (sugarcane), Whiskey (grain). Each brings one dominant flavor profile. Mixologists have mastered them all — and are hungry for something new.

The New Frontier

Baijiu offers five distinct flavor dimensions in one bottle — floral from wheat, sweet from glutinous rice, robust from durra, clean from rice, round from corn. One spirit, infinite possibilities.

The Timing

Global cocktail culture has never been more adventurous. Mezcal went from obscure to essential in 10 years. Japanese whisky conquered the world. Baijiu is next.

Market Gap
The "four plus one" framing is crucial — it positions WRD G⁵ as an addition to the mixologist's toolkit, not a replacement. It respects existing culture while claiming a new space.

Why Mixologists Will Love It

One Spirit.
Five Flavor Dimensions.

isn't just "Chinese vodka." It's a flavor symphony that gives mixologists unprecedented creative freedom. Each grain contributes a distinct note — and together, they harmonize with virtually any mixer.

Floral + Citrus? The wheat notes sing.
Sweet + Tropical? Glutinous rice delivers.
Bold + Smoky? Durra provides the backbone.
Clean + Herbal? Rice keeps it crisp.
Rich + Creamy? Corn rounds it out.

5 Flavor Notes Infinite Recipes
This slide speaks directly to bartenders and mixologists — the key influencers who will drive adoption. The "five flavor dimensions" concept gives them a creative framework, not just a product.

Pillar 03

The Content

Three short-form video concepts engineered to make this brand go viral.

Each video concept is designed for 30-60 second formats. All use English voiceover and on-screen text. The "Give Me Five" gesture should appear in every video as a signature move.

Video Concept 01 — Discovery

"The Fifth Base Spirit"

A 45-second video that introduces as the newest essential for every bar cart.

Creative Approach

Open with a bartender lining up five bottles: vodka, gin, rum, whiskey... and pausing. "Every great cocktail starts with a base spirit." Cut to four classic cocktails — Martini, Mojito, Old Fashioned, Daiquiri. "But what if there was a fifth?" Enter . Quick cuts of five colorful cocktails being made, each highlighting a different grain's flavor. The bartender slides a cocktail across the bar. Customer takes it, smiles, and they high-five. Voiceover: "Give Me Five." (Pronounced: Rodge FIVE)

Video Concept 02 — Education

"Five Grains, Five Cocktails"

A 60-second tutorial showing how each grain in inspires a different cocktail creation.

Creative Approach

A charismatic mixologist stands behind a light green bar. " is made from five grains — and each one inspires a different cocktail." Wheat: A floral gin-style cocktail with elderflower and cucumber. Rice: A clean, minimalist highball with yuzu. Durra: A bold, smoky Old Fashioned variation. Glutinous Rice: A creamy, tropical colada-style drink. Corn: A rich, buttery whiskey sour twist. Each cocktail is a different color. Final shot: all five glasses arranged in a row, the mixologist raises a hand for a high-five to camera. "Give Me Five." (Pronounced: Rodge FIVE)

Video Concept 03 — Culture

"The High-Five Drink"

A 45-second lifestyle video built around the social ritual of the high-five. A group of diverse friends at a rooftop bar. Someone orders a round of colorful cocktails. As they receive their drinks, they high-five each other — "Give Me Five!" The camera captures the joy, the clinking glasses, the golden hour light. Voiceover: "Some drinks you sip. Some drinks you share. — Give Me Five." (Pronounced: Rodge FIVE)

The high-five becomes the brand gesture — a universal symbol of celebration that transcends language and culture.

Social Ritual Viral Gesture Shareable
Target: Socially active millennials and Gen Z. Goal: Make WRD G⁵ synonymous with celebration and friendship. Platform: TikTok + Instagram Reels. The high-five gesture is the key viral mechanism — easy to replicate, universally understood, and instantly tied to the brand.

The Content Engine

A System Built for Virality

Beyond the three hero videos, needs a continuous content engine that keeps the "Give Me Five" momentum alive.

🎬 Hero Content

Three launch videos (45-60s) with professional production. These establish the brand world, the "Give Me Five" gesture, and the five-cocktail repertoire. Released simultaneously across all platforms.

📱 Always-On Content

Weekly short-form videos: "Five-Second Friday" (quick cocktail tips), "Grain of the Week" (deep dives into each grain's flavor), "High-Five Moments" (UGC reposts of people doing the gesture).

🤝 UGC Engine

Launch the #GiveMeFiveChallenge — users film themselves doing the high-five gesture with a cocktail. Best entries win prizes, get featured on brand channels, and become part of the brand story.

🌍 Localization

Adapt content for key markets: US (craft cocktail culture), UK (pub and bar scene), Australia (outdoor lifestyle), Southeast Asia (tropical mixology). Same brand, local flavor.

Content System
The content system is designed for sustainability — hero content creates the brand world, always-on content keeps the conversation going, and UGC turns consumers into brand ambassadors.

Pillar 04

The Launch

From content to culture — how we turn this brand into a global phenomenon.

This section covers the practical execution — influencers, platforms, timeline, and metrics.

Launch Playbook

Execution & Success Metrics

How we roll out — and how we know is working.

📱 Platform Strategy

TikTok: #GiveMeFiveChallenge, trending audio partnerships, bartender collaborations.
Instagram Reels: Aesthetic cocktail content, influencer takeovers, Stories polls.
YouTube Shorts: Longer tutorials, brand documentaries, mixologist masterclasses.

🎯 Influencer Tiers

Macro (500K+): 5 mixologists / lifestyle creators for hero content.
Mid (50K-500K): 20 bartenders / food creators for recipe content.
Micro (10K-50K): 100 local bar accounts for grassroots buzz.

📊 Success Metrics

Phase 1 (Months 1-3): 10M+ video views, 100K+ #GiveMeFiveChallenge entries, 50K+ followers.
Phase 2 (Months 4-6): 500+ bars stocking , 50K+ recipe downloads.
Phase 3 (Months 7-12): Top-10 trending spirit on Drinks International, distribution in 10+ countries.

🗓 Timeline

Month 1: Content production, influencer casting.
Month 2: Soft launch with bartender community.
Month 3: Global campaign launch + #GiveMeFiveChallenge.
Month 4-6: Optimize, scale, expand to new markets.

Execution
The execution plan prioritizes speed and testability. We launch fast, measure obsessively, and double down on what works. The #GiveMeFiveChallenge is the key viral mechanism — low barrier to entry, high shareability, and direct brand association.
